notes.title: New Update Is Live Now!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, everyone!

Thank you all for the incredible wave of support and, most of all, for the feedback on the [b]new patch[/b] we recently put into Open Beta. With your overwhelmingly positive responses, nothing stands in the way of [b]bringing this patch to the live version for all players[/b].

Once again, thanks so much to everyone who helped with testing! And if you haven’t had the chance to check out the updated game yet, now’s the perfect time to jump back in and enjoy yet another playthrough of Space Rangers HD: A War Apart.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Change Log:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Graphic resolution list now works correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing flagship to repair equipment even if galactic tech level wasn’t high enough[/p][/*][*][p]Special congrats texts now display correctly after capturing systems for pirates or upgrading equipment at Dominion[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug when combat programs weren’t given to player after destroying Bertors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with opaque windows at Shadow of the empire’s bridge[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug when portal generator could work incorrectly if some loot marked for picking up by player was present at the system, now pick up list is cleared after landing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing coalition war operation not to work properly at very long playtime (over 179 years)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues at “Musical Festival” quest[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various text mistakes and mistypes[/p][/*][*][p]Two new audio tracks from our great composer, NiKiNiT!
[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/214730/Space_Rangers_HD_A_War_Apart/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Update for Space Rangers HD: A War Apart is Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to share some great news – a brand new update is ready! Before we release it to the public, though, we'd like to let you, our dearest community, test it a bit first.[/p][p]The testing is happening on a beta branch on Steam. [b]To access the Open Beta branch, head to your Steam Library, right-click Space Rangers HD: A War Apart, left-click Properties, left-click Betas and from the drop-down menu select the option "public_beta"[/b]. notes.title: Try Upcoming Fulqrum Publishing Games at Steam Next Fest Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

Steam Next Fest is upon us! With so many titles to choose from this week, it’s easy to get lost. And that’s why [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/]Fulqrum Publishing[/url] is on hand, with a diverse selection of three demos among which we are certain you can find a new favourite! Will you to take a stand  in the eternal conflict between Arcane Magic and Steampunk Revolution in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/]New Arc Line[/url], prove your political brilliance in a grand strategy that will take your legacy to the stars in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/url], or become a master of sword and magic in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182420/VED/]VED[/url]? 

[u][b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/]New Arc Line[/url][/h3]
[/b][/u]
Take a stand in the eternal conflict between Arcane Magic and Steampunk Revolution and tip the uneasy balance between sorcery, elves, dwarves and mysterious monsters on one side and steampunk gadgets, zeppelins, and tesla guns on the other in this single-player, party-based, story-rich RPG.

In the demo, you will be thrown right into the middle of a deadly epidemic of the Iron Plague - select from 2 classes and play as either a Voodoo Shaman or a Diesel Engineer of either the Human or Elven race, and investigate what's going on in the Leprosarium; a hospital specializing in treating patients in the Slums district suffering from the horrific disease. With several ways of completing the quest and moral decisions to make along the way, will you rise to the occasion?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/


[u][b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/url][/h3][/b][/u]
Prove your political brilliance in a grand strategy like no other: pick any contemporary country, set up your government and navigate the pitfalls of domestic and international politics. A glorious destiny awaits - the domination of not just the Earth, but the whole Solar system!

The demo will allow you to govern either Germany or Mexico, and you will have 5 in-game years to show off your cunning leadership skills in the new, extreme Overdrive mode. At launch, any contemporary nation will be available for your ambitions, from Afghanistan to Zimbabwe and everything in between, and you will be able to enjoy different campaign modes to boot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/


[u][b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182420/VED/]VED[/url][/h3][/b][/u]
VED is a story-driven, hand-drawn RPG with a unique turn-based combat system and roguelite elements. Set in two different worlds, VED tells the story of Cyrus, a young hero who sets out on a quest to become a master of sword and magic, and save everything he knows from destruction.

The demo will let you sneak a peek at a very early part of the game's story - just enough to whet your appetite, but with no significant spoilers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182420/VED/


We are excited to hear what you think about the demos - please consider joining their individual Discord servers, and don't forget to wishlist and follow each of the games you like, so you can always stay up to date - there are many important announcements coming soon!
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/enAVFHEANh]New Arc Line Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/ZwXekHkTDK]Realpolitiks HQ Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/KXkq2SG6gS]VED Discord[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: New Update Has Arrived to Build 2.1.2468
notes.content:
Greetings, Space Rangers!

We have great news for you! A brand-new patch has just arrived, bringing fixes to several bugs. On top of that, we've also added a fan-made Spanish translation to the game. Full changelog is available below.

Doesn't this sound like the perfect time to replay Space Rangers?

[h3][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug forcing Keller to stop his attacks after the player talked with some NPC in the system;
[*] Fixed a crash after picking up large nodes amount at the extended cargo hold view and then clicking at another items in the cargo hold;
[*] Fixed various text mistakes and mistypes;
[/list]
[h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Update to Build 2.1.2448 is Live Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4462176/cceb869a5645a5c7e40d6342b3acee02f9564a14.png[/img]

Space Rangers, report in!

To make advancing in your careers a little easier and more fun for you, we have prepared a patch for [b]Space Rangers HD: A War Apart[/b]! It fixes various bugs that might have hindered your progress, but also brings a new quality of life feature that we hope will come in handy!

[h3]Full Changelog:[/h3]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pressing F11 now deletes saved price lists from notification bar first, and other messages only if they were not found
[/list]
[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Clan pirates strength is reduced by one division for new games (i.e. now clan pirates at 100% difficulty is like they were at 50% before the patch)
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug leading to warrior ships delayed take-off from military base after a hyperjump
[*] Fixed save file corruption when NPC pilots got more than 255 medals
[*] Fixed a bug in the “Assortment” quest, causing to count 0 carriages of certain type on a rails as a reason for fines when combined with different carriages types on the same rail
[*] Fixed a bug in the “Prison” quest, causing relation to player not to change despite giving your roommates some alcohol
[*] Fixed a bug in planetary battles, preventing robots from firing when the game uses more than 2 GB of RAM
[*] Fixed a bug in planetary battles, causing AI to pay less than needed for robot head parts
[*] Fixed various text mistakes and mistypes
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/214730/Space_Rangers_HD_A_War_Apart/

notes.title: Updated Build 2.1.2442 is out now!
notes.content:
The fleet greets you, Admirals,

The Universe expects you to do your best and it should get much easier for you now! We hope the experience now gets even more enjoyable!

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could lead to losing picked up items by NPC ships
[*] Fixed missing random sounds on pirate planets
[*] Fixed incorrect search filter algorithm application for Esodapher's minimal damage
[*] Fixed MS Visual C++ library dependency error that could prevent the game from launching for certain players
[*] Fixed various text mistakes and mistypes
[/list]

[h3]Additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new fine tuning option to allow equipment switching in black holes
[*] Added new fine tuning option to allow using an old speed calculation formula
[*] Added new fine tuning option to allow using an old rocket damage calculation formula
[*] Added feature to center camera on mission target by clicking on pop-up notification
[*] Added feature to center camera on a planet with idle research probes by clicking on pop-up notification
[*] Added information message if hyperjump is cancelled on the fly due to fuel shortage or engine malfunction
[*] Micromodules damage bonuses are now displayed in search results
[*] Added new features for modders
[/list]

notes.title: Space Rangers HD: A War Apart update 2.1.2436 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4462176/115f10b1574d0ba44bc591d0bb5dc61ad651f9c7.png[/img]

Greetings space rangers! 

We are back with another update for Space Rangers HD. This update improves the planet name generator, brings in a bunch of bugfixes and also adds new new features for the modding community! So start up your thrusters and get back into action! 

Read the full changelog below:
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Planet generator now uses all the available names for it;
[*] Fixed possible bug while using the galaxy map button and government hotkey simultaneously on a planet
[*] Fixed a bug in search service – focus remained tied to invisible input field when displaying search results;
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused text quest illustrations not to update properly
[*] Fixed a loan maximum interest didn’t have a cap (now maximum loan sum with interest capped to 100 million cr.)
[*] Fixed robbed ships behavior -  after dropping their cargo they will not shoot it
[*] Fixed incorrect walls on arcade battle map “The chase”
[*] Fixed a crash while using built-in SR2LoadingScreen mod in the English version of the game
[*] Fixed a crash when switching tabs at arcade battle menu using Tab hotkey
[*] Fixed various text mistakes and mistypes
[/list]
[h3]Additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new features for modders
[/list]

notes.title: Space Rangers - patch 2.1.2424 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4462176/115f10b1574d0ba44bc591d0bb5dc61ad651f9c7.png[/img]

Greetings Space Rangers!

We are back with another update, this time bringing in bugfixes, balance changes and some new additions to the game! So waste no time and get back into space!

You can read the full changelog below:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Diplomat’s incorrect arrival location in one of the female special agents missions
[*] Fixed potential deposit account overflow during very long playtimes
[*] Fixed incorrect Foncer’s technical description in “Foncers” text quest
[*] Fixed various text mistakes and mistypes
[/list]

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Max cap for Pirates and Dominators strength are now set to 500% when using advanced adjustment settings (was 200% before)
[*] Torpedoes now return only to the exact weapon, which fired them instead of any of the same type before (even if it was placed at the cargo hold)
[/list]

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new built-in mods: classic quest player skin from original SR2, animated loading screen from original SR2
[*] Added new SEED cheat code to input needed galaxy map generation seed (available only when using advanced adjustment settings). The code should be entered at advanced adjustment screen
[*] Added new features for modders
[/list]
